name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: Image with initials fallback, four sizes and an overlapping group, built on Reka UI.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { AvatarProps } from './index'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { AvatarRoot, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { avatarVariants } from './index'

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<AvatarProps>(), {
  size: 'default',
})
const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class', 'size', 'label')
const forwardedProps = useForwardProps(delegatedProps)
</script>

<template>
  <AvatarRoot
    data-slot="avatar"
    :data-size="props.size"
    v-bind="forwardedProps"
    :role="props.label ? 'img' : undefined"
    :aria-label="props.label"
    :class="cn(avatarVariants({ size: props.size }), props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </AvatarRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { AvatarFallbackProps } from './index'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { AvatarFallback, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui'
import { computed, useSlots } from 'vue'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

const props = defineProps<AvatarFallbackProps>()
const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class', 'name')
const forwardedProps = useForwardProps(delegatedProps)
const slots = useSlots()

const initials = computed(() => {
  const words = props.name?.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean) ?? []
  if (words.length === 0)
    return ''
  const letters = words.length === 1 ? [words[0]!] : [words[0]!, words.at(-1)!]
  return letters.map(word => Array.from(word)[0]).join('').toUpperCase()
})
</script>

<template>
  <AvatarFallback
    data-slot="avatar-fallback"
    v-bind="forwardedProps"
    :class="cn(
      'flex size-full items-center justify-center bg-muted font-medium text-muted-foreground',
      'text-xs group-data-[size=sm]/avatar:text-[0.625rem] group-data-[size=lg]/avatar:text-sm group-data-[size=xl]/avatar:text-lg',
      props.class,
    )"
  >
    <slot>
      <template v-if="!slots.default">
        {{ initials }}
      </template>
    </slot>
  </AvatarFallback>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { AvatarImageEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import type { AvatarImageProps } from './index'
import { reactiveOmit } from '@vueuse/core'
import { AvatarImage, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

const props = defineProps<AvatarImageProps>()
const emits = defineEmits<AvatarImageEmits>()

const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, 'class')
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(delegatedProps, emits)
</script>

<template>
  <AvatarImage
    data-slot="avatar-image"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="cn('aspect-square size-full object-cover', props.class)"
  />
</template>
